items.title: Claude Code's Thariq Shihipar says he has left Anthropic
items.takeaway: He named no next step and pointed followers to other Claude Code team members.
items.soWhat: One of Claude Code's best-known builders is leaving; watch where he lands next.

items.title: Aikido says the Brotli flaw reaches many HTTP libraries
items.takeaway: Aikido calls the wider variant HTTP2Shell; fixes are not yet out for every affected service.
items.soWhat: Patching Node.js alone may not close it, so track Brotli 1.2.1 upgrades across dependencies.

items.title: China requires job-risk reviews for AI projects with large employment impact
items.takeaway: State Council guidelines set 18 tasks and urge advance notice and an unemployment buffer period.
items.soWhat: Firms automating in China should plan worker notice and transition support before scaling AI.
